name: nightingale
description: Open-source, self-hosted monitoring and alerting for metrics, logs and databases. Connect Cursor to Nightingale's built-in MCP server.

N9E_MCP_URL.title: Nightingale MCP URL
N9E_MCP_URL.description: Full URL of your Nightingale instance's built-in MCP endpoint, including /mcp, for example https://n9e.example.com/mcp. Use an address reachable from the Cursor client.

N9E_TOKEN.title: Nightingale personal token
N9E_TOKEN.description: Personal token created under Profile > Token management in your Nightingale instance. Its API and business-group permissions apply to every tool call.
